permits.raw_text: SAMPLE DATA - NOT A REAL TCEQ NOTICE. APPLICATION. [SAMPLE] Fictional Ready-Mix #1 has applied to the Texas Commission on Environmental Quality (TCEQ) for an Air Quality Standard Permit for Concrete Batch Plants, Registration No. SAMPLE-100001, which would authorize construction of a new concrete batch plant located near Lyons Ave and Lockwood Dr, Houston, Harris County, Texas 77020. The proposed facility will emit the following contaminants: particulate matter including particulate matter with diameters of 10 microns or less (PM10) and 2.5 microns or less (PM2.5). The facility is proposed to operate up to 8,760 hours per year at a maximum production rate of 300 cubic yards per hour. Emissions will be controlled by water sprays at aggregate stockpiles and transfer points, a fabric filter (baghouse) on the cement and fly ash silos, and paved, watered in-plant roads. PUBLIC COMMENT. Written public comments may be submitted to the Office of the Chief Clerk or electronically at www14.tceq.texas.gov/epic/eComment/. The comment period for this sample notice ends on November 5, 2026.
